answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 170595 Country: India Title: Sajda e Tilawat Question: If I am reciting the Quranic verse which has Sajda, multiple times in one go, (let’s say if I am memorizing that verse) do I need to perform Sajda so many times? Answer ID: 170595 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 967/809/B=09/1440) If you recite Ayat-e-Sajdah in the same meeting repeatedly then only one Sajdah Tilawat will be wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
